Organize any page cleanly across desktop and mobile (390px responsive stack) with 21 structure, workspace, and navigation builders.

Python builder YAML type What it renders aiui.layout(children, *, refresh_every, params, badges, notifications) Page root Top-level page payload (_components), optional polling, URL params, live badges & notifications aiui.columns(children) columns Responsive horizontal grid (stacks cleanly on mobile) aiui.chat_panel(*, title="Agent Chat", agent, height=520, session_id, welcome) chat_panel Embedded compact Agent Chat panel for split-pane workspaces (e.g. aiui.columns([doc_viewer, chat_panel])) aiui.container(children, *, title) container Bordered section wrapper with optional heading aiui.card(title, *, value, footer) card Clean summary or KPI card aiui.card_grid(items, *, columns=3) card_grid Responsive grid of entity cards (image, title, subtitle, badges, link) aiui.tabs(items, *, lazy=False) tabs Tabbed panel; set lazy=True to load heavy tabs on first click aiui.accordion(items) accordion Collapsible FAQ / multi-section list aiui.expander(title, *, children, expanded, lazy, load) expander Single collapsible drawer with optional lazy loading aiui.list_detail(items, *, selected, detail) list_detail Master-detail split view (selectable list on left, details on right) aiui.board(columns=[...]) board Kanban board with horizontal status columns and cards aiui.stepper(steps, *, active=0, orientation="horizontal") stepper Multi-step workflow or onboarding progress (pending, active, done, error) aiui.timeline(items, *, title) timeline Chronological vertical activity & audit feed with timestamps and status dots aiui.tree_view(nodes, *, title, default_expanded) tree_view Collapsible hierarchical tree for RAG sources, files and agent hierarchies aiui.header(text, *, level=2) header Section heading (h1–h4) aiui.divider(text=None) / aiui.separator() divider / separator Horizontal rule (optionally labeled) aiui.breadcrumb(items) breadcrumb Navigation trail (Home / Analytics / Overview) aiui.pagination(total=..., page=1, per_page=10) pagination Paged controls for large datasets aiui.link(label, *, href, external) link Inline safe hyperlink aiui.link_button(label, *, href, variant, external) link_button Button-styled hyperlink aiui.page_link(page_id, label, *, params, variant) page_link Instant client-side navigation to another app page (no reload)
